channel.title: Taiwan on Wing's Travel Notes
channel.description: Recent content in Taiwan on Wing's Travel Notes

item.title: Qixingshan: Taipei's volcanic summit
item.description: Cross Qixingshan from Xiaoyoukeng to Lengshuikeng, with fumaroles, two summits, and public transport at both ends.

item.title: Tainan: two days of history and food
item.description: Walk the old centre on day one, then give Anping its own afternoon and sunset rather than commuting back and forth.

item.title: Taipingshan: two days in the cloud forest
item.description: Stay overnight to give Taipingshan Villa, a heritage trail, Cuifeng Lake, and Jiuzhize room to breathe.

item.title: Wulai: waterfall, Atayal food, and hot springs
item.description: A simple Taipei day trip pairing Wulai Old Street and Atayal flavours with the waterfall and a private hot-spring finish.

item.title: Xiaoliuqiu: three low-carbon island days
item.description: Base near Baisha Harbor, use the island shuttle, and let a licensed guide lead snorkeling, diving, or intertidal visits.

item.title: Qilai Nanhua: three days via Tianchi Lodge
item.description: Base the route at Tianchi Lodge, putting permits, beds, weather, and turnaround times ahead of reaching both summits.

item.title: Green Island: three days paced around the sea
item.description: Keep arrival, diving, and the island loop on separate days so that safety and sea conditions set the schedule.

item.title: Hehuanshan: high mountains via Cingjing
item.description: Travel from Taichung through Cingjing, then let altitude, weather, and the booked shuttle determine the mountain day.

item.title: Hualien: coast, sunrise, and slow days
item.description: Use Hualien Station as a base and give the city, Qixingtan, and the north coast their own unhurried days.

item.title: Jiaoxi: hot springs, waterfall, and Yilan food
item.description: Travel from Taipei to Jiaoxi, linking Tangweigou, Wufengqi, and a shared meal of Yilan specialities.
